reuse.why: All month-wide consumers use the shared category selector, and the new action reuses existing tag, month, spreadsheet, budget-write, batching and undo abstractions.

duplication.why: The repeated category-selection queries are consolidated, although the new action repeats the income-versus-tracking eligibility guard.

placement.why: Category selection and budget calculations stay in budget/actions.ts, with handler registration and undo wrapping in budget/app.ts.

scope.why: The changes are limited to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, relevant tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: A single selector makes the evolving exclusions easy to maintain, though income eligibility remains distributed and its return type unnecessarily promises group_hidden.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six month-wide actions call getMonthWideCategories, and group tags are parsed through extractTagsFromText.

disguised_duplication.where: The shared selection logic replaces repeated queries; the remaining repeated income guard is explicit rather than disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthWideCategories gains the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter and one conditional selecting the hidden SQL filter; every month-wide action continues through it.
